newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Renaissance recommends buying Surgut preferred.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance recommends buying Surgut preferred.

text.p: Renaissance Capital on Wednesday recommended buying into weakness in Surgutneftegaz preferred shares over the next four to six weeks, as the oil company prepares to issue Level-1 American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on preferred shares.

A proposed issue of preferred shares could cause the price of Surgut prefs to slip if the market remembers Surgutneftegaz's controversial share issue last October, the Moscow investment bank said in a research note.
Surgutneftegaz will hold a shareholders' meeting on March 22 to propose an issue of 166 million authorised but unissued preferred shares.
But Renaissance predicted the share price will rebound once the company's Level-1 ADR for preferred shares is approved.
"Surgutneftegaz and Surgut Holding remain two of the most fundamentally strong oil companies in Russia," it said.
Last October Surgutneftegaz's majority shareholder Surgut Holding (NK Surgutneftegaz) announced it had taken up an entire share issue by Surgutneftegaz.

After protests by other shareholders the company agreed to issue rights to shareholders allowing them to buy extra voting shares in proportion to their holdings while Surgut Holding raised the amount it was paying for the shares it had taken up.
At 1310 GMT, Surgutneftegaz preferred shares had fallen to $0.533 from $0.540 at Tuesday's close. Surgutneftegaz ordinaries had risen to $0.777 from $0.750.
